articleTitle: D2D Resource Allocation Optimization Algorithm Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: In the cellular network framework, the resource allocation problem for Device-to-Device (D2D) communication technology is particularly critical. The core issue is how to efficiently allocate channel resources to D2D users while minimizing interference to cellular users (CU), ensuring the overall performance and Quality of Service (QoS) of the network. To address this challenge, This letter has proposed a resource allocation strategy based on deep reinforcement learning algorithms, aimed at dynamically adjusting channel allocation and transmission power in D2D communication. Firstly, an in-depth study and analysis of the conflicts and interference issues between D2D communication and cellular users in the cellular network environment regarding channel reuse are conducted. By quantitatively analyzing the impact of signal interference on communication quality, key factors requiring optimization are identified. Secondly, Double-Actor Critic (D-AC) algorithm is developed for dynamically allocating communication channels and adjusting transmission power. This algorithm iteratively optimizes D2D channel reuse and power control strategies, aiming to balance the efficient use of channel resources with the minimization of signal interference. Thirdly, the D-AC algorithm is implemented and evaluated for its effectiveness in enhancing system throughput, reducing collision probabilities, and maintaining quality of service standards. By comparing with existing resource management schemes, the advantages of the D-AC algorithm are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Investigation of Gradient Curing on the Characteristics of Low Temperature Silver Paste
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: This research investigates the influence of the resin curing process on the electrical conductivity and soldering adhesion in low-temperature silver paste, used in heterojunction cells (HJT). Adjusting the dosage of high-temperature and low-temperature curing agents was carried out in this study to achieve a gradient curing profile, which is characterized using Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC). The results indicate that the gradient curing strategy enhances the compactness between silver particles after resin curing, thereby improving the electrical conductivity of the cured layer. Moreover, gradient curing improves the adhesive bond between the cured layer and the battery sheet, thus increasing the welding drawing force. The optimized silver paste, with a resistivity of 5.7 μΩ·cm and a welding drawing force of 2.0 N, meets the stringent requirements of industrial production for these two parameters.

articleTitle: Semantic Research on Model-Driven Code Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: Targeting the issues of incomplete and imprecise theoretical frameworks, as well as lacking a solid theoretical foundation in the current domain of model-driven engineering, this paper proposed a formal semantic description method for code generation technology. The method is oriented towards the MCL metacrypto language. Firstly, it introduced domain-specific languages for cryptographic algorithm development: the MCL metacryptal language and the MCL model. Secondly, based on category theory and component-based software architecture models, it provided a formal description of the process from the MCL model to the MCL metacrypto language. Finally, combining the formal description with the Blockly framework, it implemented the XOR meta-model. This approach not only clarifies the fundamental principles to be followed in the model-driven code generation process but also extends the existing theoretical frameworks, offering new ideas and methods for research and practice in both cryptographic algorithm development and model-driven engineering fields.

articleTitle: Study of a Telescope System Based on Holographic Optical Elements
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: In this paper, a telescope system based on holographic optical elements (HOEs) is developed and used for 3D object imaging experiments. First, the principle and fabrication method of HOE are introduced, and the optimal parameters for HOE recording are obtained through test experiments. Then, the HOE telescope system was constructed for experimental demonstration, and the degree of diffraction reproduction image reconstruction was evaluated by calculating the structural similarity. The experimental results show that the holographic optical telescope system can realize good imaging effect and different magnification effects by replacing HOEs with different focal lengths, and the holographic optical telescope system can flexibly adjust the telescopic magnification compared with traditional telescopes.

articleTitle: Research on Hydrogen Gas Sensing Mechanism of Micro and Nano Ionization Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: The detection of hydrogen gas (H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) is crucial for predicting incipient faults in transformers and ensuring the safe operation of smart grids. Micro-nanotip-based micro-ionization sensors, characterized by fast response speed, easy integration, and resistance to concentration saturation, have the potential to meet the emerging demand for detecting fault feature gases in transformers. By establishing a mixed micro-corona discharge fluid model of N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> as the research object, this study investigates the discharge characteristics of different concentrations of hydrogen gas and simulates the change in sensor electrodes’ sensitivity to hydrogen gas concentration under the same discharge condition. Further analysis reveals a single-value sensitivity law of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentration based on ion generation rate during different concentrations discharge process from perspectives such as density distribution of positive ions and generation rules of positive ions. It is found that N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> metastable is consumed by H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, leading to decline in discharge current, qualitatively the sensing mechanism of micro-corona discharge type sensor for hydrogen gas is revealed.

articleTitle: Electricity Price Prediction Model Based on EEMD-KPCA-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: The traditional electricity price prediction methods in the electricity market lack a certain degree of stability. In order to improve the accuracy of electricity price prediction during peak and valley periods, this paper proposes a electricity price prediction method based on EEMD-KPCA-LSTM. Firstly, quantifying the correlation between electricity price data and its influencing factors by calculating correlation, selecting main features as inputs, and using EEMD to decompose the sequence of main environmental factors. Then, KPCA is used to reduce the dimensionality of the model input and preserve the main features of the data. Finally, an EEMD-KPCA-LSTM prediction model was constructed using the LSTM network. A case study was conducted on the measured data of a certain regional electricity market, and compared with LSTM, the proposed method was verified to have higher prediction accuracy and computational efficiency. The RMSE and MAE of the EEMD-KPCA-LSTM prediction model proposed in this paper were reduced by 5.7682 and 2.4438, respectively.

articleTitle: Study on Hardware Trojan Design and Implantation Based on Chisel
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: As the complexity and scale of digital integrated circuits increase, the level of chip design and verification continues to improve, and traditional design languages can no longer meet current demands. In response to these challenges, the Chisel language has emerged, providing a new tool for hardware Trojan design. This paper presents the design of an AES-T100 hardware Trojan using the Chisel language. This hardware Trojan features an always-on design and steals key information through internal activation. Functional simulations and scheme verifications have been conducted, and the test results show that compared to a Verilog-designed hardware Trojan, the Chisel-designed hardware Trojan chip achieves a maximum main frequency increase of 74.41MHz and a throughput increase of 25%, while only occupying 0.21% of the total code’s logic utilization. This demonstrates Chisel’s significant advantages and resource efficiency in hardware Trojan circuit design. Therefore, Chisel possesses higher efficiency and optimization capabilities in hardware design, making it highly valuable for research in hardware Trojans.

articleTitle: Analysis of Multi Physical Field Parameter Mapping for Unbalanced Operation of Transformers Based on Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to effectively measure the changes in winding current, internal magnetic leakage, and vibration characteristics of transformers during three-phase unbalanced operation in distribution networks, a transformer unbalanced operation twin model based on digital twin technology is proposed. Firstly, the physical entity information of electromagnetic mechanical coupling is collected through transformer dynamic simulation experiments, and a virtual twin entity is established and simulated to simulate the internal physical form of the transformer under different states. Secondly, extract the physical parameters of the electromagnetic and mechanical fields inside the transformer, and establish a twin database based on the fusion of virtual and real information. Then, the potential correlation between electromagnetic field and mechanical field is studied using winding current as a twin bond, and its virtual mapping relationship is established; Finally, use observable electrical information to describe the changes in unobservable physical information such as magnetic fields and mechanical fields. The model constructed in this article can provide a new means for multi physical evolution analysis of transformer unbalanced operation.

articleTitle: Effect of Grating Diffraction Efficiency on Output Coupler Free External Cavity Spectral Beam Combining Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: The output coupler free external cavity spectral beam combining structure uses the beam along 0-order and 1-order diffraction direction as the feedback light beam to realize the wavelength locking of the emitters, which avoids the waste of 0-order and 1-order diffracted beams, and high beam-combining efficiency can be obtained. The diffraction efficiency of the diffraction grating has an important influence on the beam-combining structure’s feedback efficiency and output efficiency. In this paper, the influences of grating diffraction efficiency on the wavelength locking of unpolarized light and the beam combining output efficiency are simulated and analyzed, and the stable wavelength locking of emitters can be achieved when the grating diffraction efficiency is 78.9%–92%. As a result, the highest beam-combining output efficiency can be achieved by using this external cavity spectral beam combining structure with output coupler free.

articleTitle: Research on Kalman Filter Parallel Computing Method Based on OpenMP
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: Kalman filtering is an algorithm widely used in state estimation of dynamic systems, and its wide applications include navigation, tracking and control systems. However, the computational complexity of Kalman filtering makes it inefficient when processing large-scale data. This paper studies the parallel processing method of Kalman filtering, and improves the execution efficiency of the algorithm by dividing the filtering process into blocks and parallelizing them. Through experiments on simulated data of sinusoidal signals plus Gaussian white noise, the significant advantages of parallel processing methods in computing time are verified, and the influence of block processing on filtering results is discussed.

articleTitle: Study on Electromagnetic High Reflection Performance of Artificial Metamaterial and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: Based on the novel transmission characteristics of electromagnetic wave in the metamaterial board, the reflection and transmission properties of the common-metamaterial multilayer structure slabs are researched, and the equations of total reflection and transmission coefficients are deduced, the validity of the approximate formula under the condition of small reflection is studied. The results show that the multilayer dielectric slabs with common-metamaterial structure constructed scientifically have high-performance electromagnetic reflection performance, and the high-performance reflective coating made from it has important application value for improving electromagnetic external shielding performance.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study of Time-Sensitive Network for 5G Fronthaul Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: Vertical industries such as industrial control networks and internet of vehicles have extremely high performance requirements for the reliability and certainty of 5G networks. The application of time-sensitive networks characterized by bounded deterministic transmission to the fronthaul networks of 5G is of great value in improving the end-to-end deterministic capability of 5G, and is gradually becoming a research hotspot. This paper first introduces the fronthaul network and time-sensitive network and the integration deployment of the two, then analyzes the factors affecting the quality of fronthaul network service, and describes the comparative test scheme of TSN and optical fiber for 5G fronthaul network, which provides a basis for the feasibility of TSN carrying 5G fronthaul network and lays a foundation for the evolution and deployment of TSN carrying 5G fronthaul network.

articleTitle: An Active Regression Learning Method for Quality Evaluation of Molecular Dynamics Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: Training deep potentials for molecular dynamics simulations via active learning methods is a prevalent technique. However, a significant drawback of this method is its tendency to get trapped in confined regions during conformational searches, potentially resulting in datasets with redundant information. In this research, we propose the integration of active regression learning to construct regression models that link data energy and its distribution to quality scores. This approach enables us to assess the quality of each data entry within the dataset. We have validated our method on three datasets, and the outcomes demonstrate its exceptional proficiency in eliminating lower-quality data points from molecular simulation datasets.

articleTitle: Wideband Polarization Insensitive Radar Wave Absorber/Reflector
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband polarization-insensitive abs orber/reflector with multi-function switchability is proposed. The active components are integrated within the frequency selective surface(FSS), while the PIN diode serves as a circuit switch to enable switchable functionality. The bias network of the PIN diode is well integrated into the active frequency selective surface(AFSS) and no dedicated bias lines are required. The impact of dedicated bias lines can be significantly alleviated. The bias network responsible for different polarization directions is geometrically separated by a pair of vias, which can be switched between the four working states by controlling the horizontal and vertical direction diodes respectively. In addition, the proposed structure has a wider operating bandwidth and good polarization insensitivity characteristics compared to previous switchable absorber/reflector designs. Surface current and equivalent circuit model physical analysis methods are used to help better understand the operation principle of switchable absorber/reflector.

articleTitle: Identification and Processing of Abnormal Data in Differential GNSS Dynamic Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: In order to suppress the effect of abnormal data in differential GNSS dynamic measurement, an identification and processing method based on first-order differential time series and sliding window plus bidirectional fitting extrapolation is proposed. The method firstly identifies and locates the lost data based on time series, then completes the forward and reverse fitting extrapolation of the outliers by sliding window of fixed length point by point, and obtains the weighted fusion of estimation of the outliers according to the inverse distance weighting method. The simulation results show that the method can solve the identification and extrapolation problem of lost data points and outliers in the whole curve, and does not affect the normal data.

articleTitle: Design of Integrated Energy Monitoring System Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: To fully utilize limited energy resources and address the inefficiencies in existing energy management, the authors proposed a comprehensive energy monitoring system design based on cloud computing, starting from the perspective of system network architecture. This system leverages existing resources effectively and incorporates overall scheduling, real-time monitoring, and predictive functionalities. The system operates on a cloud computing platform, processing data from three types of energy metering devices generated by sensors (electricity meter, water meter, gas meter) to provide users with real-time energy consumption data, represented as (0.50, 0.23, 0.10). These values are very close to the actual power consumption values (0.47, 0.21, 0.08), within an acceptable energy consumption range, achieving an average accuracy of 98%. This proves the high accuracy of cloud computing in remote real-time data transmission. Furthermore, the system utilizes the high reliability and scalability of cloud computing to offer integrated resource management, customized application, and virtualization platform switching services to customers, enabling information-based management of energy reserves, consumption, and equipment operation.

articleTitle: High Energy Narrow Pulse Width Electro-Optical Q-switched Nd: YVO4 Oscillator Without Output Coupler
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate a kHz high energy narrow pulse width electro-optical Q-switched Nd:YVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> oscillator without output coupler, the resonator is composed of residual reflection from the pump surface and a total reflection mirror. By using a pulsed fiber coupled LD pump source, the thermal effects of Nd:YVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> can be effectively alleviated. One end facet of the Nd:YVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> crystal was cut at the Brewster angle to replace the polarizer, thereby reducing the length of the resonator. At a repetition rate of 2 kHz, the laser output achieved the highest average power of 1.49W with an optical-to-optical conversion efficiency of 17.8% and a maximum single pulse energy of 0.745mJ. Additionally, a good beam quality with M<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=1.20 and M<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</inf> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=1.24 was obtained. The research results presented in this paper greatly enhance the practical applicability of the laser without output coupler, which can be utilized as an oscillating stage in the MOPA (master oscillator power amplifier) configuration.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Calibration and Temperature Influence Analysis of High Temperature Resistant Fiber Optic Grating Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: This article completes the precise calibration of strain and temperature under high temperature conditions through the construction of a sensitivity calibration test bench for high-temperature resistant fiber Bragg grating sensors, and deeply explores the mechanism of temperature’s influence on sensor strain sensitivity. The test results show that the temperature sensitivity is 12.06pm/°C, the strain sensitivity is 0.3567pm/με, and the linearity of both is above 0.99. The repeatability is excellent, and the measurement results are stable with small dispersion and good stability. The study also provided temperature compensation formulas and parameters for strain measurement, which are suitable for strain monitoring applications in high-temperature environments. The experiment observed that with the increase of temperature, there is a slight nonlinear increase in strain sensitivity, which is attributed to five key factors: temperature changes causing thermal optical effects leading to spectral redshift, differences in material thermal expansion coefficients affecting strain transfer, nonlinear response of temperature and load superposition effects, poor degradation performance of interface constraints and adhesive layers at high temperatures, and nonlinear effects of prestressing. These findings provide scientific guidance for understanding and mitigating the impact of temperature on strain sensitivity, helping to optimize high-temperature sensor design and ensure reliable monitoring accuracy in extreme environments.

Author Keywords: high-temperature resistant fiber optic grating sensors

articleTitle: An Advanced Sequence Recommendation Model Based on Temporal Mixed Attention and Dynamic Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: In the realm of natural language processing (NLP), the advent of cutting-edge models like BERT has revolutionized the field, significantly enhancing the efficiency of sequence recommendation systems. However, current models such as BERT4Rec often overlook crucial emotional and contextual information embedded within user sequences, primarily focusing on historical interaction data for analysis. This gap in understanding user preferences and behavior is problematic as it limits the depth and personalization of recommendations. To address this, we introduce a novel model called MAY, specifically tailored for sequence recommendations. MAY aims to integrate user sequences with relevant data, enabling a deeper comprehension of user preferences and behaviors, including emotional and contextual factors. At the heart of the MAY model lies a unique time-mixed attention mechanism that enhances the self-attention function in sequence processing. This mechanism allows MAY to capture a broader range of user preferences and behavior patterns, leading to more accurate and personalized recommendation results. To validate the effectiveness of MAY, we conducted extensive experiments on multiple public datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that MAY significantly outperforms traditional benchmark models, such as BERT4Rec, across various metrics. This underscores the superiority and practical potential of MAY in the domain of sequence recommendations. By addressing the limitations of existing models and introducing a novel approach, MAY offers a promising step forward in enhancing the quality and personalization of sequence recommendations.

articleTitle: Non Field of View Imaging System of Single Photon LiDAR Combined with BM3D Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: Single photon LiDAR is a new type of LiDAR technology based on weak light detection, which can achieve single photon detection and counting. Single photon LiDAR technology is closely integrated with weak light detection, ultra long distance detection, artificial intelligence and other technical fields, and has achieved multiple research results. It has been applied in fields such as autonomous driving, national defense and military, environmental monitoring, aerospace, etc. Single photon LiDAR has achieved many results in the imaging field, but there are few studies involving imaging of non field of view. This article built a single photon counting based LiDAR system, and combined traditional algorithms with BM3D imaging, and used spatially relevant photon denoising techniques to achieve imaging of occluded objects, After testing, this system can achieve non field of view imaging with a spatial resolution of no less than 100×100 at interfaces with different reflectivity.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Airborne High Oblique View Synthetic Aperture Radar System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: The main working area of airborne high squint SAR is within the high squint angle range. It can observe the target area in advance, effectively improve the concealment and combat efficiency of the carrier aircraft, and has important research significance. This paper designs a strip mode airborne SAR system under high squint conditions. First, the constraint relationship between the various parameters of high squint SAR is analyzed and sorted out. The antenna size is limited by resolution, bandwidth, range ambiguity and the size of the carrier fuselage, and the size of the antenna directly affects the antenna gain and radiation pattern, and then affects the system’s resolution, power and other performance parameters. For the selection of PRF, four aspects are considered, namely Doppler bandwidth, azimuth ambiguity, range ambiguity and system real-time processing capability. Second, the high squint SAR system process is designed, and the system ambiguity requirements are advanced to the PRF parameter design link. In the system performance analysis step, only the system sensitivity value is used for judgment, reducing the number of design process cycles before the final parameter confirmation. Finally, a system design is carried out for a strip-mode high-squint SAR example. The bandwidth, antenna size, and PRF system parameters are determined in combination with the aircraft flight conditions and fuselage size limitations. The effects of different resolutions, different aircraft flight altitudes, and different slant ranges and squint angles on the above parameter designs are summarized, and the rationality of the parameter design is judged using the system sensitivity value.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Sensing Device for Adaptive Life Signs in Deformation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: A deformation-adaptive wireless vital signs sensing device has been designed to ensure the safety of firefighters during fire and rescue operations and address the compatibility issues between the protection and comfort of existing emergency rescue personal protective equipment. Based on a flexible sensor deformation adaptation model, the device employs photoplethysmography to measure the firefighter’s heart rate, blood pressure, and respiratory rate. It gauges skin temperature by analyzing changes in the resistance value of thermal resistors. Calibration experiments were conducted in five different activity intensity settings to assess the relationship between sweat volume and skin resistance values, aiming to evaluate the perspiration status of firefighters. For data transmission, the device utilizes the low-power Bluetooth 5.2 protocol to ensure efficient and stable information transfer. Testing has confirmed that the device developed in this study can monitor the vital signs of firefighters at disaster scenes in real-time and support the effective transmission of data to the command center at the rear. This facilitates commanders and firefighters in promptly understanding the operational status, playing a crucial role in ensuring the safety of firefighters and assisting command personnel in making scientific and reasonable decisions.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Viewpoint Holographic Optical Elements for AR Display
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-view holographic optical element (HOE) was developed for use in augmented reality (AR) displays, with a primary emphasis on its fabrication process, testing, analysis, and performance enhancement. The research outcomes demonstrate that the fabricated HOE successfully enables multi-view display, exhibiting high diffraction efficiency and superior imaging quality, thus presenting a novel solution for the further integration of AR display systems. Compared to conventional binocular stereoscopic display techniques, this approach effectively addresses the convergence-accommodation conflict, expands the eye movement range in AR glasses, and enhances user comfort.

articleTitle: Airborne Electromagnetic Data Leveling Based on Structured Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: Airborne electromagnetic method has the advantages of fast and efficient, non-contact, multi-parameter acquisition, high cost performance and strong adaptability, and has been widely used in geological mapping, mineral resources, underground water sources, environment and engineering exploration. However, because the flight mode is inevitably affected, the data difference between routes will be generated. This difference in data is represented in the imaging system as a bar graph parallel to the flight line. This structural model motivates us to build a leveling error model utilizing an anisotropic Gabor filter. Then the leveling error model is embedded into the total variational frame to avoid blind removal of leveling error. In addition, the structured variational method can also be expanded to eliminate various other types of noise with a broad prior noise assumption. We utilized the method on airborne magnetic data gathered by the Geological Survey of Ontario and juxtaposed the outcomes with published data to authenticate its reliability. Leveraging the spatial attributes of leveling error, the structured variational method proves beneficial for effectively leveling aerial geophysical data.

articleTitle: Central Air Conditioning Demand Response Capability Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: In view of the unclear ability of central air conditioning to participate in demand response, this paper first introduces the process of central air conditioning to participate in demand response, and then analyzes the ETP model of air conditioning. Based on the parameters of the ETP model, the operating state of air conditioning is divided into four operating states: on, off, static temperature setting and dynamic temperature change. Finally, based on LSTM neural network combined with static temperature setting and dynamic temperature change of air conditioning, the demand response capability evaluation was carried out, and the demand response potential of central air conditioning was obtained, which provided an effective calculation basis for central air conditioning to participate in demand response.

articleTitle: A Polarization-Insensitive Broadband Metamaterial Absorber with Controllable Absorption Intensity
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: The work presents a wideband, polarization-insensitive, and dynamically tunable metamaterial absorber. The absorber is constructed with a simple design consisting of a top layer circular array loaded with four PIN diodes, a middle dielectric substrate, and a bottom metal layer. Simulation results illustrate that by adjusting the bias voltage applied to the PIN diodes, the absorber can dynamically tune from near-total reflection to below −13 dB over a broad frequency range spanning from 4 to 12 GHz. Additionally, the absorber maintains its polarization insensitivity due to its symmetric structure. An accurate equivalent circuit is developed to explain the underlying physical mechanism of the absorber, and the absorption peaks are analyzed by examining the electric field distribution. Experimental samples of the absorber are fabricated and tested, demonstrating close agreement with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Varifocal Methods Based on Digital Holographic Lens Recording
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: This paper proposes a holographic lens reproduction zoom method based on different focal lengths, grounded in computational holography theory. A series of holographic lenses with different focal lengths are recorded in the holographic material by using a spatial light modulator (SLM) to simulate a lens to realize the light wave modulation effect. The results of the study surface that the zoom function can be realized by changing the relative positions of the fabricated holographic lenses in order to switch between different digitally recorded holographic lenses used for imaging, which provides a new solution for the realization of zoom systems. The feasibility of the proposed method is verified by combining the test results with theoretical analysis. Compared with the traditional mechanical zoom method, the digitally recorded holographic lens zoom method does not need to precisely adjust the spacing of the lens group, reduces the system volume, has a lower production cost and has a wider scope of application.

articleTitle: Power Cycling and Research on Failure Mechanism of Press-Pack IGBT based on Thermal Resistance Composition Testing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: Press-pack insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) is widely used in transmission systems due to its high reliability and short-circuit failure modes. However, there is a lack of research on the failure mechanism of elastic press-pack IGBT. For the elastic press-pack IGBT sub-module, based on the principle of electrical measurement, this paper designs a power cycling test system for power cycling test and thermal resistance measurement. Based on the structure function method, the changes of electrical properties and thermal resistance after power cycling are studied. The reliability and failure mechanism of the elastic crimp IGBT sub-module are analyzed, and the conclusion that the gate oxide layer damage is the main failure principle is obtained. The work of this paper fills the gap in the practical application of elastic press-pack IGBT.

articleTitle: Research on Graph Feature Data Aggregation Algorithm Based on Graph Convolution and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: I Aiming at the wide application of graph data in the field of machine learning and deep learning, this paper proposes a novel graph feature data aggregation algorithm. The algorithm is an innovative fusion of Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN) and Attention mechanisms. Traditional graph convolution methods may have problems of information loss and excessive smoothing when processing complex graph structure data, but the attention mechanism can dynamically assign different weights to different nodes or edges, so as to effectively capture key features in the graph and improve the learning ability of the model. In this paper, we first review the basic principles of graph neural networks and attention mechanisms, and then elaborate the proposed algorithm framework. By embedding an adaptive attention mechanism in the graph convolution layer, the algorithm not only enhances the selective extraction ability of node neighborhood features, but also enables the model to adaptively adjust the information aggregation process according to the importance of the relationship between nodes, thus improving the differentiation of feature representation and the generalization performance of the model. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, we carried out validation on different experimental tasks.

articleTitle: Research on QoS-Sensitive Interference Avoidance Algorithm Based on Multi-Beam Coordinated Scheduling for Beam Hopping Satellite Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: This paper investigates the downlink resource allocation and beam scheduling strategy for beam hopping satellite system. To avoid the co-frequency interference caused by multi-beams dwelled in adjacent cells, a QoS-sensitive Interference Avoidance Algorithm based on Multi-Beam Coordinated Scheduling (QIMC) is proposed. Initially, an interference threshold model is established based on the clustering mapping relationship between beams and cells. Subsequently, an objective function is constructed based on delay thresholds and cache capacity, which is used to differentiate the priority of beam scheduling. Then the Maximum-Largest Weighted Delay First (M-LWDF) function is optimized to consider the system performance, integrating throughput, traffic demand, and service fairness, which achieves real-time joint scheduling and space-time domain resource allocation for Inter-cluster beams. The QIMC algorithm enhances system reliability by mitigating interference between adjacent cells and ensures the QoS requirements for differentiated traffic. Simulation results show that the QIMC algorithm safeguards the traffic demands by reducing the Packet Loss Ratio (PLR) and average delay, and improves the system throughput. This demonstrates the superiority of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Intra-Domain Routing for Aeronautical Ad Hoc Networks Based on Enhanced Optimized Link State Routing Networking
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Materials and Information Engineering (EMIE)
abstract: Based on Mobile Ad Hoc Network (MANET) technology, Aeronautical Ad Hoc Networks (AANETs) bring a new direction for aeronautical communication. By applying AANET technology, data transmission between airplanes is achieved through multi-hop routing, overcoming the limitations of ground base station coverage. The extensive coverage of AANETs renders traditional single-domain management methods unsuitable, necessitating research into efficient, low-cost, and reliable, domain-based routing schemes, including inter-domain and intra-domain routing. This paper focuses on intra-domain routing, improving the Optimized Link State Routing (OLSR) mechanism. A mathematical model for Multi Point Relay (MPR) selection is established and solved using linear programming, proposing a full-network topology-based MPR selection algorithm. This reduces the number of MPR nodes, simplifies the network topology, and includes a message redundancy check strategy to reduce the redundant forwarding of Topology Control (TC) messages. To minimize end-to-end delay, hop count, and maximize bottleneck bandwidth, Multi-Objective Intra-Domain Routing algorithm for Aeronautical Ad Hoc Networks Based on Enhanced OLSR Networking (MIRA-OLSR) is proposed. This algorithm integrates the improved networking mechanism with multi-objective optimization, achieving flexible, low-cost, and reliable intra-domain routing. Simulations using real flight data verify that, compared to the benchmark algorithm, MIRA-OLSR achieves the lowest end-to-end delay and hop count, the highest forwarding success rate and bottleneck bandwidth, while reducing the number of forwarding times of broadcast packets compared to OLSR. This results in low-cost, reliable, high-bandwidth, and low-delay intra-domain routing.
